incidents.message:
• 2012-10-25 19:49:42 - We are currently investigating problems with saving wiki pages for some repositories. We will update this issue when we have more information to report.
  • 2012-10-25 20:00:43 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-24 13:34:16 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-24 13:34:16 - A small number of repositories are unavailable while we perform emergency maintenance on a fileserver pair.
  • 2012-10-24 13:39:24 - Service to all impacted repositories has been restored.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-22 21:17:47 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-22 21:17:47 - The status website is misreporting availability of services again. Git and Downloads are both available.
  • 2012-10-22 21:25:45 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-22 18:33:12 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-22 18:33:12 - The status website is currently experiencing some intermittent performance problems. Git and Downloads access on GitHub.com are working correctly.
  • 2012-10-22 19:50:37 - The status website is reporting service availability normally again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-22 15:24:14 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-22 15:24:14 - We are investigating slow response times for some Pages.
  • 2012-10-22 15:27:06 - Pages response times are back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-22 06:52:17 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-22 06:52:17 - We're investigating an increased rate of search index job failures.
  • 2012-10-22 08:07:57 - Search indexing is working normally again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-19 21:16:49 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-19 21:16:49 - A small percentage of git repos will be unvailable while we recover a fileserver pair. Updates as we have them.
  • 2012-10-19 21:25:00 - All git repositories are now accessible.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-19 19:15:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-19 19:15:00 - We are investigating issues with pages serving.
  • 2012-10-19 19:41:33 - Pages is currently being hit with a DoS attack. We're working to mitigate the attack.
  • 2012-10-19 20:22:51 - We're still working to mitigate the attack on Pages.
  • 2012-10-19 21:11:21 - GitHub Pages service has returned to normal. All systems go!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-18 20:05:57 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-18 20:05:57 - We are investigating issues with GitHub.com
  • 2012-10-18 20:17:08 - We're experiencing some connectivity issues at the moment. GitHub.com is currently unavailable while we resolve this.
  • 2012-10-18 20:33:42 - "We are experiencing issues due to a DDOS attack, working hard to restore service"
  • 2012-10-18 20:41:02 - We've temporarily disabled service on port 80 while we investigate the source of a connection flood. HTTPS, GIT, and SSH service are unaffected.
  • 2012-10-18 20:41:39 - Performance is still substantially sub par as we fend of the connection flood. We're on it.
  • 2012-10-18 21:44:00 - Performance is stabilizing. We're investigating additional mitigation strategies to harden ourselves against future attacks, similar or otherwise.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-17 12:50:19 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-17 12:50:19 - We're looking into errors with our search service. Updates as we have them.
  • 2012-10-17 21:14:50 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-17 01:44:17 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-17 01:44:17 - Some users may be experiencing issues connecting to github.com. We are currently investigating the issue however at the moment it appears to be a network issue at one of our upstream providers.
  • 2012-10-17 01:44:21 - We are investigating network connectivity issues.
  • 2012-10-17 02:10:30 - The upstream connectivity issues have been resolved.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-15 23:04:41 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-10-15 23:04:41 - GitHub Pages was down from 3:50-3:59 pm. We're investigating the cause.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-14 09:47:38 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-14 09:47:38 - We are investigating errors with GitHub.com and API
  • 2012-10-14 09:55:40 - All connectivity issues have been resolved.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-11 14:31:25 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-11 14:31:25 - GitHub Shop is down due to an upstream provider outage. We're tracking the issue and will update again when service is restored.
  • 2012-10-11 14:33:06 - GitHub Shop is back up. All systems go!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-10 17:53:38 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-10 17:53:38 - We are investigating issues with the website.
  • 2012-10-10 17:56:00 - GitHub.com is down, we are continuing to investigate and will provide an update once we know more.
  • 2012-10-10 18:00:20 - Connectivity to the site has been restored. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-08 21:11:41 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-08 21:11:41 - We're performing emergency maintenance on one of our fileservers. A small percentage of repositories will be unavailable for the duration of this maintenance. We'll update again when everything's back up.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-08 17:42:05 UTC
incidents.message:

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-05 18:04:43 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-05 18:04:43 - A small percentage of git repositories are unavailable due to a heavily loaded fileserver pair. Investigating.
  • 2012-10-05 18:15:07 - We've failed over to the secondary fileserver in that pair. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-10-05 04:54:50 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-10-05 04:54:50 - Users are unable to create new repositories and some repositories are unable to push new changes. We're investigating.
  • 2012-10-05 05:15:05 - Everything is back to normal now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-28 20:30:52 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-28 20:30:52 - Email delivery is a bit delayed right now. We're working through the queue backlog now and we'll update again when the backlog has been emptied.
  • 2012-09-28 22:00:13 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-26 13:41:07 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-26 13:41:07 - We are investigating timeouts when using the website.
  • 2012-09-26 13:50:09 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-20 16:51:58 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-20 16:51:58 - We are investigating issues with merging Pull Requests.
  • 2012-09-20 17:16:28 - We've resolved the issues with Pull Requests.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-20 14:46:59 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-20 14:46:59 - Job queues are backed up -- we are investigating.
  • 2012-09-20 14:57:12 - We lost a worker node and are working to bring that back online. Until then the job queue will be slow to process the backlog.
  • 2012-09-20 15:08:39 - We've brought the node back online and are now processing through the backlog. This will take some time.
  • 2012-09-20 15:49:12 - The job queue has caught up and returned to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-19 13:54:43 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-19 13:54:43 - Job queues are backed up -- we are investigating.
  • 2012-09-19 14:02:23 - We are working through a backlog in our job queue. Please sit tight as we churn through them...
  • 2012-09-19 15:16:40 - We've caught up on processing many of the higher-priority jobs in the job queue. Lower-priority jobs are still backlogged.
  • 2012-09-19 15:37:32 - The job queue has returned to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-14 01:38:26 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-14 01:38:26 - Investigating connectivity problems on HTTP port 80.
  • 2012-09-14 01:42:00 - Connectivity issues have been resolved.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-11 20:56:56 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-11 20:56:56 - Issue, Repository, and User search indices may be returning incorrect results after today's DB maintenance. We're rebuilding the search index now.
  • 2012-09-12 02:09:02 - Search indexes are still missing some results. We're working on backfilling through the night.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-11 15:19:48 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-11 15:19:48 - Connectivity problems. Investigating
  • 2012-09-11 15:25:21 - Investigating DB problems
  • 2012-09-11 15:35:53 - We've taken a bad DB down and are working to return the DB cluster to a normal state now.
  • 2012-09-11 15:58:52 - DB cluster is slowly recovering.
  • 2012-09-11 16:10:16 - Performance is still impacted such that the majority of requests are hitting unicorns. Caches are slowly warming.
  • 2012-09-11 16:27:39 - Unicorns are decreasing in frequency.
  • 2012-09-11 16:38:34 - Performance is returning to normal.
  • 2012-09-11 16:50:51 - Performance is largely back to normal. We'll be following up with more information on this outage and our plans to resolve the issues on the blog soon.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-11 14:27:52 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-11 14:27:52 - Processing through a queue backlog. We'll update when we're all caught up.
  • 2012-09-11 14:42:46 - All caught up.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-10 14:05:23 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-10 14:05:23 - Investigating database problems.
  • 2012-09-10 14:13:45 - We failed over to one of our secondary DBs. Services are recovering, but slow.
  • 2012-09-10 14:19:33 - Back down. Investigating.
  • 2012-09-10 14:22:19 - Back on the primary DB and recovering slowly.
  • 2012-09-10 14:54:13 - Service is recovering. Performance will continue to be degraded for a short while.
  • 2012-09-10 16:29:19 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-06 16:56:24 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-06 16:56:24 - A portion of GitHub Pages sites are down. We're investigating now.
  • 2012-09-06 17:02:53 - GitHub Pages is back to normal. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-09-06 13:18:49 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-09-06 13:18:49 - We're working through a large queue of jobs this morning. We'll update again when everything's caught up!
  • 2012-09-06 13:29:44 - Queues are back to normal again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-30 13:10:36 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-30 13:10:36 - Investigating further GitHub Pages service degradation. More as we have it.
  • 2012-08-30 14:06:10 - We've made a few changes to ensure GitHub Pages is handling the increased load well. All systems go!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-30 12:55:02 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-08-30 12:55:02 - GitHub Pages experienced a brief degradation in service due to a large influx of traffic around 5:45am PDT. Service has been restored and we're monitoring the service closely.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-29 15:06:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-29 15:06:00 - We are processing through a queue backlog after we lost a cache server. We'll update again when everything's up to date!
  • 2012-08-29 15:39:21 - We've spun up some additional worker capacity to deal with the backlog.
  • 2012-08-29 16:16:38 - The backlog has been processed and we're back to realtime. Sorry about the rocky morning. We're kicking off some work to ensure job processing is more resilient in th

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-21 20:10:57 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-21 20:10:57 - github.com is down. We're investigating.
  • 2012-08-21 20:15:37 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-21 15:43:17 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-21 15:43:17 - GitHub Pages builds are delayed a bit today. We're processing the backlog now.
  • 2012-08-21 17:37:29 - The page build backlog has been completely processed. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-20 17:19:53 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-20 17:19:53 - Some page builds are currently running a little slow.
  • 2012-08-20 17:31:17 - Some pages are temporarily unavailable for a few minutes.
  • 2012-08-20 17:36:26 - All pages should be available again. Some page builds are still a little backed up.
  • 2012-08-20 22:44:10 - All page builds have caught up and all systems are normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-17 19:51:21 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-17 19:51:21 - Some pages sites are currently unavailable. We're investigating.
  • 2012-08-17 20:03:36 - All pages sites should be available now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-16 17:31:22 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-16 17:31:22 - One of our fileservers pairs has become temporarily unavailable.
  • 2012-08-16 18:02:54 - We're still working to bring the unavailable fileserver back online.
  • 2012-08-16 18:30:47 - The fileserver is back online and all systems are normal!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-16 05:42:33 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-16 05:42:33 - We've identified and resolved the cause for the failure during the database maintenance window and are proceeding with the planned database maintenance.
  • 2012-08-16 06:01:50 - The new database cluster is in place and services are beginning to come back up.
  • 2012-08-16 06:16:20 - Response times for github.com are still improving as we fix broken Unicorns. Services are available, but a little slow at the moment. Processing for queued jobs is currently disabled.
  • 2012-08-16 06:21:17 - We've re-enabled processing for queued jobs. The backlog from the maintenance window is currently being worked through.
  • 2012-08-16 06:41:07 - We've processed a bit over half of the queued jobs from the maintenance. Response time has improved significantly and is continuing to decrease.
  • 2012-08-16 06:56:26 - App response times are now completely back to normal. All job queues should be caught up except for search index updates.
  • 2012-08-16 07:12:20 - All systems normal!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-16 05:00:13 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-16 05:00:13 - We're starting our scheduled database maintenanace now. We expect to back up in a few minutes!
  • 2012-08-16 05:16:55 - We're still working on the database maintenance but we're wrapping things up now.
  • 2012-08-16 05:23:12 - We encountered some problems with the database maintenance and are now rolling back.
  • 2012-08-16 05:27:06 - Rollback is complete and all systems are now back online.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-15 21:28:43 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-15 21:28:43 - We're processing through a backlog of queued jobs. An update will be provided once we're caught up.
  • 2012-08-15 22:48:38 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-15 15:00:40 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-15 15:00:40 - We're processing through a moderate queue backlog. We'll update again when it's caught up.
  • 2012-08-15 15:13:18 - The queue backlog has been completely processed. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-08 18:07:22 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-08 18:07:22 - Spoke to soon. We're investigating networking problems causing a percentage of users to be unable to reach github.com over Git/SSH/HTTPS. More as we have it.
  • 2012-08-08 18:17:21 - The issue has been confirmed as a routing problem on Level3's network.
  • 2012-08-08 20:49:27 - Routing issues have resolved over the past few hours. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-08 17:43:15 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-08 17:43:15 - Investigating some routing problems upstream from GitHub.
  • 2012-08-08 18:00:59 - Routing problems appear to be resolved. We're investigating the cause of the problem with our upstream providers.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-08-07 15:41:17 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-08-07 15:41:17 - Investigating connectivity problems.
  • 2012-08-07 15:52:34 - Load on our databases is recovering from a rapid spike.
  • 2012-08-07 17:15:18 - All systems go.
